title: Bridge read workflow: integration and field verification

parent.objective: Bring up a host-side bridge for the fictional SYNTH-SENSOR-1 so that every component is verified independently and no hardware behavior is claimed before it is observed.
parent.milestone: Representative workflow verified over the fake sensor and observed in the field

goal: Run the representative read-and-summarize workflow end to end through adapter, device and telemetry.
non_goals: Infer field behavior from the fake-sensor integration run.

allowed: Record the operator-run field workflow as a hardware evidence record.
prohibited: Edit codec, transport, device, adapter or telemetry modules.
Attest the field check as the implementer.

inputs.name: Workflow
inputs.description: Open adapter; read N times through SensorDevice; log READING or ERROR lines; summarize; close.

inputs.name: Field procedure
inputs.description: SRC-HIL-PROCEDURE: operator runs the workflow against a physical SYNTH-SENSOR-1 in its representative setting.

outputs.name: Integration test
outputs.description: The workflow over a fake sensor presented as a port, including one corrupted reply.

outputs.name: Hardware evidence record
outputs.description: Bound record of the field run.

interface.name: bridge workflow
interface.description: Composition only; every component interface is consumed at its recorded version.

assumptions: The integration rung is the highest machine-runnable rung; a pass is still simulated success.

sources.authority: Synthetic specification invented for this example; not a manufacturer document.

sources.reference: examples/software-hardware/sample — the synthetic bridge package and its tests
sources.authority: Reference implementation for this example only; establishes no real device behavior.

sources.reference: examples/software-hardware/README.md — operator procedure for hardware-rung attestation
sources.authority: Operator procedure; each run's observations are recorded in a bound hardware evidence record.

acceptance_criteria.description: The workflow produces the specified log and summary over the fake sensor, including the corrupted reply.
The workflow completes against a physical SYNTH-SENSOR-1 in its representative setting, as observed and recorded by a non-implementer operator.

validation.description: Run the end-to-end integration tests over the fake sensor.
Operator runs the workflow in the field per SRC-HIL-PROCEDURE and records a hardware evidence record.
evidence_required: Hardware evidence record digest bound in the attestation.
Device identity, firmware and setting as observed.

context_scope: Interfaces of synth_bridge.adapter, synth_bridge.device, synth_bridge.telemetry, synth_bridge.codec and synth_bridge.fake_device (the device packet's test double) only.
architecture_boundaries: No component interface changes; composition only.

hardware_assumptions.assumption: A physical SYNTH-SENSOR-1 in its representative setting behaves as the fake sensor scripts it to.
